name: CO2 pipelines (dense phase)
principle: CO2 is compressed above its critical pressure so it flows as a dense fluid in carbon-steel pipe, which needs dry CO2 to avoid corrosion. The IPCC special report records 803 km Cortez (about 20 MtCO2/yr), a western US network above 2,500 km carrying about 50 MtCO2/yr, and Weyburn at US$110 million (1997) for 330 km.

source.note: IPCC Special Report on Carbon Dioxide Capture and Storage, chapter 4, Transport of CO2 (2005)
